pages.title: Who Turned Out the Lights?
pages.text: Who Turned Out the Lights? is a secret level of Earthworm Jim (Shiny Entertainment, 1994). Halfway through Level 5, Jim can jump into the red dot of a black box, and everything goes dark. Jim and his enemies are silhouettes, and only their eyes can be seen.

pages.title: Five rooms and a pair of eyes
pages.text: According to Sega Retro, the secret level of Earthworm Jim called Who Turned Out the Lights? has five short rooms. In the last one, a giant pair of eyes roars and chases Jim. When he escapes, three rays of light carry him back to the place in Level 5 where he left, with all his items as they were. VGMPF credits the music to Tony Bernetich.
